children: Coursera appointed Tom Savage as Senior Vice President, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary, effective September 21, 2026, while Alan Cardenas will step down as an officer as of that date and remain Senior Vice President, General Counsel through the end of 2026 to support the transition.
Senior Vice President, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary
Stepping down as an officer (will remain in role through end of 2026)
September 21, 2026 (will remain in role through end of 2026)
Decided to step down as an "officer" under Rule 16a-1(f); will support transition
Tom Savage appointed to the CLO role
Age 57; roles at IBM (VP), Red Hat (SVP & GC), Marvell (senior legal roles); partner at Wilson Sonsini; J.D. Univ. of Chicago; B.A. Harvard; admitted in CA & IL
Will continue as Senior Vice President, General Counsel through end of 2026 and is anticipated to serve as an advisor thereafter
